notes: r3: same RTL as r2 (vi_q n+3, write n+1, fault n+2); SRAM clk pins on their own balanced post-CTS branch (macro_branch.tcl, pad 1)
structural_change: HBM-SFUHW2 10-18 r3: r2 route NEEDS_RTL TT -28.63 / FF -66.08 (setup rd_out -> rd_cap launch late; hold pin flops -> SRAM inputs capture late). Post-route TT SRAM clk 288..567 ps vs registers 331..419: TritonCTS macro tree = 4 root delay buffers + one 214 ps leaf per 4-macro column, detoured in routing. Fix: physical/ref_tile/hbm_su_sfustore_hw_1018/macro_branch.tcl (PRE_CTS, bnd_branch class): after CTS the 16 SRAM clk pins move onto a dedicated balanced 3-level BUFx24 tree (trunk 6 um below the SRAM array for every cross-column split since the SRAMs obstruct M1..M4 under the M5 cap, Manhattan corner buffers, vertical column feeds only; stem at the clk port, 1 pad stage of compensation against the register mass, median H-tree columns then pairs, repeaters <= 80 um, equal buffer count), old macro-tree buffers deleted. Global-route probe on the r2 CTS placement: SRAM clk TT 388..405 vs pin flops mean 441, FF 324..346 vs 368; rd_out->rd_cap TT +123, wa_pin->w_addr_in FF hold +43. Same RTL, SDC, pins, outline, macro placement. Prior: HBM-SFUHW 10-18 r2 after r1 route NEEDS_RTL (TT -102.29 / FF -42.33 / DRC 2; job hbm_su_sfustore_hw_1018-r1-96ce9e47a). Classes (path_summary on the r1 route): setup = SRAM rd_out -> 8:1 word mux -> ~170 um wire -> S-face read_data pin flop (345 paths) + ks -> read_data (54) + qid_q -> 16-lane compare/OR -> bad_q (14 levels, fanout); hold = S-face pin flops -> SRAM wd_in/addr/ce (clock-skewed pair: macro clock ~200 ps SS after the register tree: CTS-0033 put 3 delay buffers on the macro tree and its H-tree detoured the abutted SRAM stacks, 338 ps slew). Fix: (1) RTL read capture register after the word mux beside each macro (tile-local lane bank ot_hbm_su_sfustore_hw_bank; vi_q n+3); (2) qid replicated per lane + per-lane registered compare bad_l (fault timing unchanged); (3) CTS: no macro-tree delay buffers (-delay_buffer_derate 0) and -no_obstruction_aware (s81 gather leaf precedent) so the macro clock is not later than the register tree.
